notes.title: Have You Played… A Normal Lost Phone?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Have you ever found a lost phone? If you’re not a complete wrong ‘un your first instinct was likely to find some way to reunite it with it’s owner. But there’s another urge, bubbling away just under the surface of your otherwise squeaky clean sense of morality. It’s okay, you can admit it: You sort of wanted to take a peek. It’s only natural.

notes.title: Gang Beasts, Gonner and more going cheap in a Steam charity sale
notes.notes:
A lineup of 41 lesser-known indie darlings, party favourites, curiosities and old favourites have gone on sale this week. “Sure, Nat,” you cry, “you say that, but games go on sale all the time. What’s the big deal?”. Well, dear reader, if you’d give me time to finish, I’d explain that this is a charity sale. For the rest of this week, the big-wigs over at the IGDA Foundation have set up nice little charity fundraising event.

Until the end of the One Gamer Fund charity event, 50% of the proceeds from purchasing discounted games will be split between 7 particularly game-centric charities. It’s for a good cause, yeah, so why not take a look?

notes.notes:
More than 100 000 of you bought a copy of A Normal Lost Phone! From all of us at Accidental Queens: thank you, from the bottom of our hearts!  😍 Your enthusiasm for our first production made us think you might enjoy our new game, Another Lost Phone: Laura's Story.

This game isn't a sequel to A Normal Lost Phone, but rather its spiritual successor. By solving the puzzles of this lost cell phone with a more modern design, discover a brand new tale: Laura's story...

notes.title: Another Lost Phone found in autumn
notes.notes: Our John hugely enjoyed exploring a stranger’s pocket telephone in A Normal Lost Phone, even relishing the guilt that comes with invading their privacy and interfering with their life. Good news, snoopers: French team Accidental Queens today announced that someone else has dropped their pockphone, and we’ll get to explore it this autumn in Another Lost Phone: Laura’s Story [official site]. notes.title: The Top Best Bestest Games Of 2017 So Far

notes.title: Steam cards and bug fixes
notes.notes:
We have just published an update for A Normal Lost Phone!

In addition to fixing some minor - but annoying - typos, this update fixes a bug that prevented players to request a new Be You password after receiving one by e-mail once. Players who had experienced this bug prior to the update need to restart the game by going to the game’s Settings app and picking “Erase all data”.

We took this as an opportunity to add Steam cards for the game, as well as the associated badges, emoticons and backgrounds. You can start collecting them right now!
